backfall.definition: n. A fall or throw on the back in wrestling.
backfall.translation: n. 将对方压制倒地背着垫子以取胜的手法; 滑落

backfield.definition: n. the offensive football players who line up behind the linemen

backfill.translation:
vt. 装填, 回填
n. 装填, 回填

backfilled.translation: v. 回填（挖掘的洞穴）( backfill的过去式和过去分词 )

backfills.translation: 回填（挖掘的洞穴）( backfill的第三人称单数 )

backfire.definition:
n. a loud noise made by the explosion of fuel in the manifold or exhaust of an internal combustion engine
n. a fire that is set intentionally in order to slow an approaching forest fire or grassfire by clearing a burned area in its path
n. a miscalculation that recoils on its maker
v. come back to the originator of an action with an undesired effect
backfire.translation:
n. 逆火, 回火, 放火
vi. 放逆火, 预先放火, 发生意外

backfired.definition:
v come back to the originator of an action with an undesired effect
v emit a loud noise as a result of undergoing a backfire
v set a controlled fire to halt an advancing forest to prairie fire
backfired.translation: v. （内燃机等）发生逆火( backfire的过去式和过去分词 ); 发生回火; （枪炮）向后爆发; 发生意外

backfires.definition:
n the backward escape of gases and unburned gunpowder after a gun is fired
n a loud noise made by the explosion of fuel in the manifold or exhaust of an internal combustion engine
n a fire that is set intentionally in order to slow an approaching forest fire or grassfire by clearing a burned area in its path
n a miscalculation that recoils on its maker
v come back to the originator of an action with an undesired effect
v emit a loud noise as a result of undergoing a backfire
v set a controlled fire to halt an advancing forest to prairie fire
backfires.translation: v. （内燃机等）发生逆火( backfire的第三人称单数 ); 发生回火; （枪炮）向后爆发; 发生意外

backfiring.definition:
v come back to the originator of an action with an undesired effect
v emit a loud noise as a result of undergoing a backfire
v set a controlled fire to halt an advancing forest to prairie fire
backfiring.translation: v. （内燃机等）发生逆火( backfire的现在分词 ); 发生回火; （枪炮）向后爆发; 发生意外

backfisch.translation: n. 年轻少女, 未成年的女学生
